name: Photo-Synth 2 (VST3)
description: A free Windows VST3 instrument: play the colours of four photographs. Colour becomes pitch and timbre on the first photo, the second filters it, the third shapes the envelope, the fourth drives the effects. Virtual-analog voice with a ladder filter, 16-voice pool, seven-module stereo effects rack, Dark Drone engine, MIDI and 24-bit export — all native C++ inside your DAW. Now with Automotion: Shift-drag a line or Ctrl-drag a circle onto a photo and the cursor walks it on its own, per pad, with speed, loop or one shot, direction and travel shape.
note: Windows VST3 · build 260826.3 · free download · manual and developer kit included.
